# Butter HYSA Comparator

> Local, deterministic cash-account comparisons for people and AI agents.
> Repository: https://github.com/mlo0352/hysacomp

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Agent guide and prompts](docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md)
- [Methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md)
- [Source policy and research scope](docs/DATA_SOURCES.md)
- [Tool manifest](tool-manifest.json)
- [Scenario schema](schemas/scenario.schema.json)
- [Bank schema](schemas/banks.schema.json)
- [Fictional salary scenario](examples/working-person-v3.1.yaml)
- [Bank snapshot](data/banks-2026-10-09-v3.1.yaml)
- [XML guide 3.1.0](docs/XML_GUIDE_v3.1.0_2026-10-09.md)
- [Five current prompts](docs/LLM_PROMPTS_v3.1.0_2026-10-09.md)
- [Bank discoveries](docs/BANK_DISCOVERIES_v3.1.0_2026-10-09.md)
- [Atomic fact inventory](schemas/fact-inventory.json)

Install with npm ci. Run npx tsx cli.ts --help. Inputs: YAML/JSON or versioned XML (3.1; explicit 3.0 migration supported).
Outputs: raw JSON/CSV and SVG image. No API key, remote API or MCP server required.
Report source dates, baseline-relative earnings, model exclusions and assumptions.


Feature research: docs/FEATURE_RESEARCH.md
Feature CLI: npx tsx cli.ts features --banks data/banks-2026-10-09-v3.1.yaml
Personal checks: npx tsx cli.ts verifications --banks BANKS --checks CHECKS
Unknown is not unavailable; secondary claims and personal checks are not first-party verification.
